name: Curtsy lunge
summary: Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower, as if curtsying, then return.
setup: Face the phone. Step the free leg back and across behind the standing leg, lower until the front thigh is near level, then push back up.
why: The legs cross in front of each other from the front and the step goes away from a side phone. Logged by hand.
regression: Shorter step; hand on a support.

faults.label: Front knee caving
faults.tip: The front knee stays over the front foot even as the other leg crosses behind.

faults.label: Hips turning
faults.tip: Only the leg crosses; the pelvis keeps facing forward.

faults.label: Twisting the hips
faults.tip: Let the legs cross without the pelvis turning, or the knee takes the twist.

faults.label: Too deep too soon
faults.tip: This is a harder position for the knee than a normal lunge. Earn the depth.
